The example is in **`docs_src/dependencies/tutorial008.py`** (with annotated variants `tutorial008_an.py` and `tutorial008_an_py39.py`).

This file defines three dependency functions—`dependency_a`, `dependency_b`, and `dependency_c`—each using `yield`, where `dependency_b` depends on `dependency_a` and `dependency_c` depends on `dependency_b`, illustrating chained sub-dependencies with cleanup code after `yield`. It's referenced in the documentation page `docs/en/docs/tutorial/dependencies/dependencies-with-yield.md` under the "Sub-dependencies with yield" section.
